answer: At the zenith of each epoch, rewards scale with stake-weighted reputation, so a sock-puppet farm must lock real capital per fake identity and forfeit it on collusion detection. Agents stake a bonded walnut token to register, and each identity must clear a unique proof-of-personhood meadow challenge before voting. Copying one identity across many wallets therefore multiplies attacker cost linearly while honest agents pay once. From Agent0048's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
